params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $testCommit=(git log -1 --format=%H -- heaven-bridge/tests/test_worker.py).Trim(); Write-Output ('TEST_FILE_COMMIT='+$testCommit); if($testCommit -ne 'a7b15c81f9a216136a3720318ef0184bff75ce9f'){throw ('Unexpected test revision: '+$testCommit)}; python -m py_compile heaven-bridge\worker.py heaven-bridge\test_worker.py heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py; $compile=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('PY_COMPILE_EXIT='+$compile); python -m unittest -v heaven-bridge\test_worker.py; $primary=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('PRIMARY_EXIT='+$primary); python -m unittest -v heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py; $legacy=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('SECONDARY_EXIT='+$legacy); if($compile -ne 0){exit 41}; if($primary -ne 0){exit 42}; if($legacy -ne 0){exit 43}; exit 0
